label: AWS Graviton4, c8gn.4xlarge server and client

environment.machine: AWS c8gn.4xlarge server, its processes pinned to 4 of 16 cores, and a c8gn.4xlarge client, one cluster placement group
environment.runtime: Each server at its documented setup: Rust release builds with rustc 1.100.0, OpenJDK 25.0.5, Node.js 26.13.0, Bun 1.4.4, Apache httpd 2.4.58 and nginx 1.30.6; oha 1.16.0; plain HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, no TLS, 50 Gbps between the instances

protocol.processModel: A fresh server process group per cell on the server's 4 cores, each server sizing its own workers; every server but Bun listens with actix-web's backlog of 1,024 from its own settings, since Bun.serve has none
protocol.cacheState: JSON built on every request; byte bodies from one shared buffer, or a new one per request on /323k-fresh, while Apache httpd and nginx serve them as files; the 64 MiB file stays in the page cache
protocol.output: Capacity: the highest open-loop rate held with p99 at most 50 ms, at most 0.1% errors and at least 95% delivered, doubling then bisecting three times; CPU per response from the server's user plus system time and peak memory growth from VmHWM, each summed over its processes
protocol.clientSizing: 8 oha processes, open loop with latency correction; 1,000 paced clients in the slow cells; 64 in the file cell
